text:
marco: Heads-up: polestar-40k int8 onboarding. Repro shows stable outputs vs fp16 until ~21.4k tokens then abrupt token swaps. Reproducer + logs attached.

anya: Can you share the exact command and seed?

marco: Yep:
```
./run_long_repro.sh --model polestar-40k --quant=int8 --input data/long_prompt_25k.txt --seed=7 --out /tmp/polestar_run.json
```
Observed: first mismatch token_idx=21452. Generation otherwise identical before that.

devin: Could be rotary index overflow or kv-index wrap after large sequence. Any indications of key/hash monotonicity breaking?

marco: I dumped kv_index stream with DEBUG_KV=1:
```
[kv] idx=21448 key_hash=0x9a7f12 val_len=128
[kv] idx=21449 key_hash=0x9a7f13 val_len=128
[kv] idx=21450 key_hash=0x9a7f14 val_len=128
[kv] idx=21451 key_hash=0x9a7f15 val_len=128
[kv] idx=21452 key_hash=0xdeadbe (mismatch)
```
That deadbe value doesn't match the expected incremental pattern.

maria: I ran the long-bench-25k suite across fp16/int8/int4. Int8 shows a cliff in BLEU/ROUGE starting at token ranges 21k-22k. Putting CSV in gdrive: https://drive.redwood/polestar/longbench/2026-03-23/polestar_results.csv

ci-bot: Build polestar-int8 #1209 finished  artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/polestar/1209/.

anya: If key_hash jumps to a sentinel (0xdeadbe), that suggests a sentinel is being written into the KV buffer. Could be a buffer index overflow or a memset of freed memory. I'll run a memory-access trace.

devin: On the quant side, int8 kernels reuse the same buffer for sin/cos and suf masks; if an out-of-bounds write overwrote kv keys it would explain this. I'll instrument kernels to check writes beyond table bounds.

marco: Also noticing latency spikes starting ~20k tokens on int8 (from 7.8ms to ~12.5ms) while fp16 stays stable. Might be runtime fallback or extra memcpy.

maria: Early eval summary: fp16 perplexity=11.9, int8=16.8 on longbench-25k. Token drift histogram shows concentrated mismatches in the 21k-22k window for int8; int4 fails much earlier.

devin: I'll try a quick mitigation: allocate rot_table as fp16 (persist) and load into fp32 per-thread. This will avoid small integer truncation in the dot products. Running a small smoke up to 30k now.

anya: I'll run valgrind-like tool on the serving process in canary to catch OOB writes. If we see writes to kv region around that time, we'll know it's a kernel vs runtime problem.

marco: Action plan:
- marco: create ISSUE-5012 with repro and kv dump (done)
- devin: kernel instrument + bisect quant table layout (assigned)
- anya: memory access trace on canary run (assigned)
- maria: run 5-seed eval for stability metrics and attach plots

ci-bot: ISSUE-5012 created by marco  https://issues.redwood/5012 (polestar-40k int8 kv sentinel writes causing token drift).

maria: I'll also add a regression alert in Optimize to run longctx smoke for any int8 onboard.

devin: Preliminary kernel smoke: switching to fp16->fp32 compute removed drift in my local 30k run. Perf hit ~+3% token latency. Pushing WIP PR for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/polestar/pull/34

anya: Valgrind trace shows a suspicious memset from thread 12 around timestamp 2026-03-23T14:05:02Z touching the kv buffer region. I'll correlate with kernel entry logs and post trace snippet.

marco: Thanks. We'll treat this as P0 for the active onboard. If devin's PR looks good, let's canary a patched image tomorrow morning.

maria: I'll post the 5-seed charts and the token drift heatmap here once complete.

marco: End of thread for triage; tagging devin/anya for follow-up.
